headline: Castellum Announces SEK 7.6 Billion Buyback Despite Lower Occupancy
summary: Swedish property company Castellum announced a share buyback program of up to SEK 7.6 billion in its third-quarter report, even as rental occupancy rates declined.
why: Castellum is one of the Nordic region's largest commercial real estate companies, offering insight into commercial property valuations and refinancing.

impacts.name: Castellum AB
impacts.why: Substantial share repurchases support equity prices but occur against an operational backdrop of weakening occupancy.
